<script>
(function () {
  var ARTICLES = {
    'nyt': {
      source:  'The New York Times',
      date:    'April 30, 2024',
      author:  'Kenneth Chang',
      title:   'A New Way to Hunt Killer Asteroids Is Tested. It Works.',
      body:    'A machine-learning algorithm called THOR, developed by the B612 Asteroid Institute in partnership with Google Cloud, identified 27,500 new asteroid candidates in archival telescope images — without making a single new observation. The discovery was processed using cloud computing in roughly five weeks, a task previously impossible at that scale. OpenSpace is credited for the visualizations accompanying the story.',
      img:     '../assets/images/use-cases/B612%20asteroids.webp',
      url:     'https://www.nytimes.com/2024/04/30/science/killer-asteroids-algorithm.html'
    },
    'smithsonian': {
      source:  'Smithsonian Magazine',
      date:    'May 6, 2024',
      author:  'Aaron Boorstein',
      title:   'Scientists Discover 27,500 Asteroids in Old Telescope Images Using A.I.',
      body:    'Researchers from the Asteroid Institute and the University of Washington used the THOR algorithm and Google Cloud to identify 27,500 previously undetected asteroids lurking in archival telescope data — including approximately 100 near-Earth asteroids. The work demonstrates how artificial intelligence can unlock discoveries hiding in observations already captured by existing observatories, with no new telescope time required.',
      img:     '../assets/images/carousel/goddard-openspace-mars.webp',
      url:     'https://www.smithsonianmag.com/smart-news/scientists-discover-27500-asteroids-in-old-telescope-images-using-ai-180984277/'
    },
    'nypost': {
      source:  'New York Post',
      date:    'August 3, 2023',
      author:  '',
      title:   'Potentially Hazardous Asteroid Detected With New Algorithm',
      body:    'The HelioLinc3D algorithm — developed for the upcoming Vera C. Rubin Observatory — made its first real-world discovery: asteroid 2022 SF289, a roughly 600-foot-wide potentially hazardous near-Earth asteroid. The algorithm identified the object by stitching together fragmented telescope observations across four nights that traditional detection methods had failed to link, demonstrating its power ahead of the Rubin Observatory\'s 10-year sky survey.',
      img:     '../assets/images/carousel/Burma+Tibet.webp',
      url:     'https://nypost.com/2023/08/03/potentially-hazardous-asteroid-detected-with-new-algorithm/'
    },
    'geekwire': {
      source:  'GeekWire',
      date:    'August 2023',
      author:  'Alan Boyle',
      title:   'Scientists Successfully Test Algorithm for Identifying Potentially Hazardous Asteroids',
      body:    'The University of Washington\'s DiRAC Institute tested HelioLinc3D, an algorithm designed for the Vera C. Rubin Observatory, against real survey data from the ATLAS telescope in Hawaii — and it worked. The algorithm discovered asteroid 2022 SF289 from observations that had been sitting unlinked in the archive. DiRAC director Mario Juri&#263; called the find "just a small taste of what to expect with the Rubin Observatory in less than two years."',
      img:     '../assets/images/carousel/mars-surface.webp',
      url:     'https://www.geekwire.com/2023/heliolinc3d-algorithm-asteroid-dirac/'
    },
    'astrobites': {
      source:  'Astrobites',
      date:    'April 21, 2023',
      author:  '',
      title:   'Earth Week × Astrobites 2023: Climate Communication in Education Spaces Recap',
      body:    'A recap of an Earth Week 2023 session in which Ryan Wyatt, Senior Director of Morrison Planetarium at the California Academy of Sciences, and astronomer James Lowenthal discussed how immersive visualization tools in planetarium settings can help communicate climate science to diverse public audiences. Wyatt emphasized the emotional and intellectual impact of real-time data visualization as a bridge between scientific findings and public understanding.',
      img:     '../assets/images/carousel/earth.webp',
      url:     'https://astrobites.org/2023/04/21/earth-week-x-astrobites-2023-climate-communication-in-education-spaces-recap/'
    }
  };

  var modal     = document.getElementById('pressModal');
  var mImg      = modal.querySelector('.press-modal-img');
  var mSource   = modal.querySelector('.press-modal-source');
  var mTitle    = modal.querySelector('.press-modal-title');
  var mByline   = modal.querySelector('.press-modal-byline');
  var mBody     = modal.querySelector('.press-modal-body');
  var mLink     = modal.querySelector('.press-modal-link');
  var closeBtn  = modal.querySelector('.press-modal-close');
  var backdrop  = modal.querySelector('.press-modal-backdrop');
  var lastFocus = null;

  function openModal(key) {
    var d = ARTICLES[key];
    if (!d) return;
    mImg.src    = d.img;
    mImg.alt    = d.title;
    mSource.textContent = d.source + ' · ' + d.date;
    mTitle.textContent  = d.title;
    mByline.textContent = d.author ? 'By ' + d.author : '';
    mBody.textContent   = d.body;
    mLink.href          = d.url;
    modal.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'false');
    modal.classList.add('is-open');
    document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
    closeBtn.focus();
  }

  function closeModal() {
    modal.classList.remove('is-open');
    modal.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
    document.body.style.overflow = '';
    if (lastFocus) lastFocus.focus();
  }

  document.querySelectorAll('.press-card').forEach(function (card) {
    card.addEventListener('click', function () {
      lastFocus = card;
      openModal(card.dataset.article);
    });
    card.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
      if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') {
        e.preventDefault();
        lastFocus = card;
        openModal(card.dataset.article);
      }
    });
  });

  closeBtn.addEventListener('click', closeModal);
  backdrop.addEventListener('click', closeModal);
  document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
    if (e.key === 'Escape' && modal.classList.contains('is-open')) closeModal();
  });
})();
</script>
